text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'm back~! I gave it everything I had~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Still, it feels like it's missing a little 
something... Just one more time at the 
end, like this—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...is what I wanted to do! Ugh, dammit~!
choice_data_list: But it was a fulfilling race
Let's bring home a win next time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told her that it was a great race, and 
that the fruits of her training really 
showed.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer! So if I keep working 
hard like this...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll work even harder, get stronger, 
and grow even bigger~!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Next time, I'll snag a spotless, 
buono victory!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's go home and practice! I'm 
gonna tackle you with everything I've 
got~!
choice_data_list:
B-Bumping into each other is a bit 
much...!
